Mini Grid privacy policy

Mini Grid is a game by Abhijeet Dhillon. This policy covers the web, Android, and iOS versions.

Progress and settings

Mini Grid saves your progress, scores, unlocks, and preferences on your device or in your browser so you can resume play. You can play without an account, and scores stay in local storage.

Clear the app’s data or your browser’s site data to delete your saves. Your device or browser may manage backups separately.

Android ads and privacy choices

Only the ad-enabled Android version shows the campaign ad and uses Google AdMob and Google’s User Messaging Platform (UMP). Google may process IP addresses, device and app information, interactions, diagnostics, and consent choices to deliver and measure ads, prevent fraud, and manage consent. See Google’s Privacy Policy for details on retention and deletion.

If Privacy options appears in the Android game menu, use it to review or change your ad privacy choices.

Contact

For privacy questions, email abhijeet@oneleverlabs.com.
